summary: Iteration 10/12 (post-registration event hub + Razorpay + inline page controls) — 23 new pytest tests added covering materials gating (paid/unpaid/invalid/admin), material PUT, file upload + gated download, student submissions (create→update, gating, mine), admin submissions list + CSV export, Razorpay 503 guards (create-order, verify), and public-base-url email links. 1 real bug found and fixed in backend helper. Frontend hub flows (paid view, unpaid card, notfound, no-reg redirect, submission create/update/persist, Razorpay-not-configured toast) all verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: FIXED — _is_admin_request() at server.py:1122 was checking payload.get('is_admin') but create_token() emits role='admin'. Admin could NOT bypass the paid-reg gate on GET materials / download endpoints. Now accepts both role=='admin' and is_admin truthy.

Idempotency path (line ~1466) reuses existing 'created' order and returns key_id from env WITHOUT calling _get_razorpay_client(). If keys were later cleared, this returns 200 with empty key_id instead of 503. Today it returns 503 correctly only because no prior order exists; edge-case only.
Response body field is `token` (not `access_token`). Documented for any external integrator; not a bug, but test fixtures should tolerate both.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — one of the rendered lists (likely links or documents map) is missing a key. Non-blocking but noisy in prod.

action_items: (Done) Backend _is_admin_request key mismatch fixed (role=='admin' now recognised).
(Nice-to-have) Add `key={d.file_id}` / `key={l.id}` on the links/documents .map() inside EventRegisteredPage ReadyView to silence React warning.
(Nice-to-have) In /api/payments/create-order idempotency branch, still call _get_razorpay_client() up-front so endpoint returns 503 consistently when keys are cleared mid-lifecycle.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1122 _is_admin_request — fixed here but the pattern should be replaced by a small reusable dep (e.g., optional_admin) so future dual-gated endpoints don't re-implement JWT decoding.

server.py:1278 upload_submission_file accepts reg_id as a query param on POST — while gated by _require_paid_registration, an admin wanting to upload on a student's behalf has no bypass. Acceptable but worth documenting.

server.py:1392 CSV export does not escape CR/LF inside student_name/school (only text_response is sanitised). Malicious name with newline could break rows in the admin download. Apply same `replace('\r',' ').replace('\n',' ')` to every free-text cell.
EventRegisteredPage: missing React key props — noisy warning.
Payment 503 message exposes env var names directly (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID / _SECRET) to end users via toast. Fine for SCALE admin but consider a generic message for students.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — 6/6 critical hub flows + Razorpay toast verified; admin EventHubPanel UI path not end-to-end clicked due to a browser session hiccup but backed by direct API coverage

rca of the issue: BUG: _is_admin_request() in server.py used payload.get('is_admin') while create_token() emits role='admin' — an inconsistent key causing ALL admin requests to GET /materials (no reg_id) and download event files to 401. RCA: developer wrote the helper assuming an is_admin boolean claim that never existed in this codebase. FIX: changed check to `payload.get('role') == 'admin' or bool(payload.get('is_admin'))`. VALIDATION: TestMaterialsGating::test_admin_can_read_without_reg, TestMaterialsAdminWrite::test_put_accepts_and_persists, TestEventFiles::test_upload_and_gated_download (admin branch) all now pass.
